description: This file defines the LDAPSetting class within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It models the configuration and settings for LDAP integration, including server details, bind options, user lookup settings, and data mapping, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and validation.

classes.name: LDAPSetting
classes.description: Represents LDAP configuration settings including server details, security options, user lookup settings, data mapping, and synchronization parameters for LDAP integration within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LDAPSetting with host, port, implementation, encryption, and default data mapping.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an LDAPSetting instance from a JSON string containing configuration data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the LDAPSetting instance into a JSON string, encrypting sensitive information appropriately.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server hostname.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server hostname.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server port.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server port.

methods.name: getEncryption
methods.description: Returns the encryption type used for LDAP connection.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Sets the encryption type, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the LDAP implementation type.

methods.name: setImplementation
methods.description: Sets the LDAP implementation type, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: isOptReferrals
methods.description: Returns whether LDAP server referrals are enabled.

methods.name: setOptReferrals
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP server referrals.

methods.name: isBindAnonymously
methods.description: Returns whether LDAP bind is anonymous.

methods.name: setBindAnonymously
methods.description: Sets whether LDAP bind is anonymous.

methods.name: getBindUserDN
methods.description: Returns the bind user distinguished name.

methods.name: setBindUserDN
methods.description: Sets the bind user distinguished name.

methods.name: getBindUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the bind user password, encrypted if necessary.

methods.name: setBindUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the bind user password.

methods.name: isEnable
methods.description: Returns whether LDAP is enabled.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP.

methods.name: shouldMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Checks if LDAP users should be merged with existing system users.

methods.name: setMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Configures whether to merge LDAP users with existing system users.

methods.name: getSyncInterval
methods.description: Returns the LDAP synchronization interval.

methods.name: setSyncInterval
methods.description: Sets the LDAP synchronization interval.

methods.name: getDataMapping
methods.description: Returns the user data mapping configuration.

methods.name: getUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Returns the array of LDAP user lookup settings.

methods.name: addUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Adds a new LDAP user lookup setting.
